// Per-icon data URI, included by the document header.
// Regenerate from assets/layout/web.svg if the source icon changes.
:icon-web-datauri: data:image/svg+xml;base64,
// Inline icon image -- reuses the data URI above so both the HTML and PDF stay
// self-contained. Consumed by the colophon "Link and Contact" table.
:icon-web-image: image:{icon-web-datauri}[Website,pdfwidth=0.45in,role=colophon-icon]
